```PREFIX ns: <http://rdf.freebase.com/ns/>
SELECT DISTINCT ?city ?languages ?pm_language
WHERE {
  # Find the administrative entity c representing the government of Belgium
  ?c ns:government.governmental_jurisdiction.government ns:m.0582y4 .
  
  # 1) City where the Federal Government of Belgium is located (capital city)
  ?c ns:location.country.capital ?city .
  ?city ns:base.biblioness.bibs_location.loc_type ?locTypeCity .
  FILTER(str(?locTypeCity) = "City")
  
  # 2) Languages spoken in the country where the Federal Government of Belgium is located
  ?c ns:location.country.languages_spoken ?languages .
  
  # 3) Language spoken where the Prime Minister of Belgium is located
  ?c ns:government.governmental_jurisdiction.governing_officials ?official .
  ?official ns:government.government_position_held.office_position_or_title ns:m.0df7_c8 .  # Prime Minister position
  ?c ns:location.country.languages_spoken ?pm_language .
  
  # Filters for English or language-neutral literals
  FILTER (!isLiteral(?city) || lang(?city) = '' || langMatches(lang(?city), 'en'))
  FILTER (!isLiteral(?languages) || lang(?languages) = '' || langMatches(lang(?languages), 'en'))
  FILTER (!isLiteral(?pm_language) || lang(?pm_language) = '' || langMatches(lang(?pm_language), 'en'))
}
```

```sparql
PREFIX ns: <http://rdf.freebase.com/ns/>
SELECT DISTINCT ?city ?airport ?province
WHERE {
  FILTER (!isLiteral(?city) || lang(?city) = '' || langMatches(lang(?city), 'en'))
  FILTER (!isLiteral(?province) || lang(?province) = '' || langMatches(lang(?province), 'en'))
  
  # Get the location entity where the movie "Saw V" takes place
  ?location ns:film.film_location.featured_in_films ns:m.03d243x .
  
  # Get the city where this location is situated
  ?location ns:location.location.containedby ?cityEntity .
  ?cityEntity ns:location.administrative_division.administrative_division_type ns:m.05z1d  . # city type
  ?cityEntity ns:location.administrative_division.jurisdiction_name ?city .
  
  # Also get the province of this location
  ?location ns:location.administrative_division.containedby ?provinceEntity .
  ?provinceEntity ns:location.administrative_division.administrative_division_type ns:m.06f3k  . # administrative division type: province/state
  ?provinceEntity ns:location.administrative_division.jurisdiction_name ?province .
  FILTER (STRLEN(?province) = 7)
  
  # Get airport closest to downtown of that place
  ?location ns:travel.travel_destination.how_to_get_here ?travelInfo .
  ?travelInfo ns:travel.transportation.transport_terminus ?airport .
  ?travelInfo ns:travel.transportation.mode_of_transportation ns:m.025t3bg . # airplane mode

}
LIMIT 1
```

PREFIX  rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX  rdf:  <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX  owl:  <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#>

SELECT DISTINCT  ?marriedPerson ?placeOfDeath ?company
WHERE
  { FILTER ( ?marriedPerson != ?person )
    FILTER ( ?placeOfDeath != ?person )
    FILTER ( ?company != ?person )
    FILTER ( ( ( ! isLiteral(?marriedPerson) ) || ( lang(?marriedPerson) = "" ) ) || langMatches(lang(?marriedPerson), "en") )
    FILTER ( ( ( ! isLiteral(?placeOfDeath) ) || ( lang(?placeOfDeath) = "" ) ) || langMatches(lang(?placeOfDeath), "en") )
    FILTER ( ( ( ! isLiteral(?company) ) || ( lang(?company) = "" ) ) || langMatches(lang(?company), "en") )
    ?person   <http://rdf.freebase.com/ns/people.person.quotations>  <http://rdf.freebase.com/ns/m.048gglz> ;
              <http://rdf.freebase.com/ns/people.person.spouse_s>  ?marriage .
    ?marriage  <http://rdf.freebase.com/ns/people.marriage.spouse>  ?marriedPerson ;
              <http://rdf.freebase.com/ns/people.marriage.type_of_union>  <http://rdf.freebase.com/ns/m.01bl8s>
    OPTIONAL
      { ?person  <http://rdf.freebase.com/ns/people.deceased_person.place_of_death>  ?placeOfDeath }
    OPTIONAL
      { ?person   <http://rdf.freebase.com/ns/people.person.employment_history>  ?employment .

      }
  }

```PREFIX ns: <http://rdf.freebase.com/ns/>
  ?country1 ns:government.governmental_jurisdiction.governing_officials ?official1 .
  ?official1 ns:government.government_position_held.office_position_or_title ns:m.01dp1b .
  ?country1 ns:location.country.languages_spoken ?language .

  # The country where Amharic is an official language and its prime minister

  ?country2 ns:government.governmental_jurisdiction.governing_officials ?official2 .
  ?official2 ns:government.government_position_held.office_holder ?primeMinister .
  ?official2 ns:government.government_position_held.basic_title ns:m.060bp .
  FILTER(NOT EXISTS {?official2 ns:government.government_position_held.from ?from} || 
         EXISTS {?official2 ns:government.government_position_held.from ?from . 
                 FILTER(xsd:datetime(?from) <= "2015-08-10"^^xsd:dateTime)})
  FILTER(NOT EXISTS {?official2 ns:government.government_position_held.to ?to} || 
         EXISTS {?official2 ns:government.government_position_held.to ?to . 
                 FILTER(xsd:datetime(?to) >= "2015-08-10"^^xsd:dateTime)})

  # Countries bordering the country where Amharic is spoken (expect 5 countries)

  ?adjoinRel ns:location.adjoining_relationship.adjoins ?borderCountry .
  ?borderCountry ns:common.topic.notable_types ns:m.01mp .
}
LIMIT 1
```

sparql:
PREFIX  xsd:  <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
PREFIX  rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>

PREFIX  owl:  <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#>

SELECT DISTINCT  ?otherOffice ?party

  { ?speaker  <http://rdf.freebase.com/ns/event.public_speaker.speeches_or_presentations>  ?speech .
    ?speech   <http://rdf.freebase.com/ns/event.speech_or_presentation.speech_topic>  <http://rdf.freebase.com/ns/m.02mdg>

        ?partyTenure  <http://rdf.freebase.com/ns/government.political_party_tenure.party>  ?party
        FILTER ( ?party != ?speaker )
      }
  }

question: In which country is the calling code 240, and the people speak Portuguese?
sparql:
PREFIX  xsd:  <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
PREFIX  rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX  rdf:  <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX  owl:  <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#>
PREFIX  dc:   <http://purl.org/dc/elements/1.1/>

SELECT DISTINCT  ?x
WHERE
  { FILTER ( ?x != <http://rdf.freebase.com/ns/m.05zjd> )
    FILTER ( ( ( ! isLiteral(?x) ) || ( lang(?x) = "" ) ) || langMatches(lang(?x), "en") )
    <http://rdf.freebase.com/ns/m.05zjd>
              <http://rdf.freebase.com/ns/language.human_language.countries_spoken_in>  ?x
      { ?x  <http://rdf.freebase.com/ns/location.country.iso_numeric>  "024" }
    UNION
      { ?x  <http://rdf.freebase.com/ns/location.country.calling_code>  ?num
        FILTER ( xsd:integer(?num) > 55 )
      }
    UNION
      { ?x  <http://rdf.freebase.com/ns/location.country.calling_code>  ?num }
  }
ORDER BY DESC(xsd:integer(?num))
LIMIT   1
